execution_design.one_continue_scope: Once a surviving MCCS tranche is governed-started, one owner Continue carries it through implementation, required validation, verified closeout and next-tranche selection unless an OPS3 owner-only boundary or genuine external blocker is reached.
execution_design.preload_rule: Load only the selected surviving tranche and its declared dependency closure; block unrelated source archaeology and other-family work.
execution_design.closeout_rule: Reserve at least 8 minutes of the 24-minute tranche target for focused validation, evidence verification, reconciliation and successor marking.
execution_design.split_rule: Split before governed start if the selected surviving tranche cannot credibly preserve the closeout reserve.
execution_design.retry_rule: Do not rerun an unchanged deterministic failure; require changed evidence before retry.

boundaries: MCCS is creator-facing appearance/presentation tooling and does not become canonical Character, NPC, Creature, Species, Form, Inventory, Asset or relationship authority
CAPP/PPIA retain renderer-neutral appearance authority; MCCS supplies creator draft/authoring UX and renderer/output adapters
PAPT/PCA retain generic character asset, rig, garment, motion, image/sprite, style-generation and local-production primitives
MNCS retains NPC/creature/group/population identity and composition; historical MCCS-17 survives only as visual-variation recipes in MCCS-16
ARI/PCA retain generic identity/rights/provenance/version/review/import-export infrastructure; MCCS-19 owns appearance-schema mapping and loss reporting only
visual controls and renderer derivatives never silently create canonical anatomy, mechanics, equipment ownership, relationship, population or live-state truth
MCCS is topology-first rather than humanoid-first and must expose unsupported/unresolved anatomy instead of forcing humanoid mapping
Animation/Scene/Combat/Dialogue owners retain runtime action/pose/placement authority; MCCS-11 is preview/authoring only
Packet 07 retains generic preview/recovery/debug semantics; MCCS supplies appearance-domain operations/lenses
generic DCC/sculpt/rig/image capabilities use lawful mature libraries/local tools or PCA/PAPT capabilities where practical rather than being rebuilt
P3D remains deferred and separate; MCCS-19 preserves a handoff seam without activating physical/3D miniature implementation
MNCS may rotate after reduced MCCS-01 only when the other MNCS DAG prerequisites are satisfied; MCCS-21 remains an MNCS golden-proof dependency
no paid/cloud character provider is required for blocking workflows
no MCCS implementation authority exists until a future OPS3 CURRENT.json governed start selects a surviving MCCS work item
